# Default provider may trigger unexpected initialization

build_embedder defaults to provider 'openai' when the config omits a provider, which will attempt to construct an OpenAIEmbedder (and import/initialize the openai SDK) even if the caller did not intend to use OpenAI.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/llm/embeddings.py` — `knowledge_compiler.llm.embeddings.build_embedder`

## Affects

- [knowledge_compiler.llm.provider](../component/knowledge-compiler-llm-provider.md)
